notes.title: Update 0.1.4: New Resources mode, Steam Achievements & more!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! This update brings several improvements and a brand-new game mode. Let’s dive into the details.

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] New “Resources” Mode: Merge resources, complete tasks, and earn gold.
[*] Added 63 Steam Achievements!
[*] Engage area hint when adding or moving a warrior.
[*] New resource: “Resin,” now dropped by the forest.
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed “Paced” Mode, replaced by the new “Resources” Mode.
[*] Reduced music volume for a better experience.
[*] Improved warrior move flag functionality, making it clearer and less confusing.
[/list]

[h3]Code Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated icons, scrolls, and generators data structure.
[*] Updated warriors and enemies data structure.
[*] Improved AI for warriors and enemies for smoother behavior.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed combination hint sometimes showing overlapping icons.
[*] Fixed warriors stuttering upon reaching their destination.
[/list]

I hope you enjoy this update! As always, thanks for your support and feedback!
